home.addr.body.zh: 总线上有两个地址，只差最低一位：A0h 是 1010000X，A2h 是 1010001X，其中 X 是读写位。A0h 放身份与静态参数，A2h 放诊断、阈值与校准常量；两块各 256 字节，互不覆盖。A2h 的字节 127 是页选择，128-255 的内容随它换页。
home.addr.body.en: Two addresses sit one bit apart: A0h is 1010000X and A2h is 1010001X, where X is the read/write bit. A0h holds identity and static parameters; A2h holds diagnostics, thresholds and calibration constants. Each block is 256 bytes and neither overwrites the other. Byte 127 of A2h is the page select, and bytes 128-255 change with the page it names.

home.bus.body.zh: 主机与模块之间只有两根信号线：一根时钟，一根数据。所有读写都走这条两线串行总线，没有额外的控制线。
home.bus.body.en: Host and module share just two wires: one clock, one data. Every read and write — including address selection — travels on this two-wire serial bus, with no extra control lines.

home.cal.body.zh: 诊断量怎么读，取决于模块声明的校准方式。内部校准：模块用自身的内部常量换算好，A2h 96-105 直接给出物理量。外部校准：模块只给出 A/D 原始计数，读数要拿 A2h 56-91 的常量自己算。
home.cal.body.en: How you read a measurement depends on the calibration the module declares. With internal calibration the module converts using its own constants, so A2h 96-105 already holds physical values. With external calibration the module reports raw A/D counts, and you apply the constants at A2h 56-91 yourself.

home.figure.caption.zh: 图 4-1 把两块地址空间按字节区间摊开：两个地址列共用一把尺子，框高与字节数成比例，太窄的分区抬到一行字的高度。A0h 从 0 一直铺到 255；A2h 的 0-127 是固定字段，127 处的页选择决定 128-255 落在下面四类页里的哪一类。页是互斥的备选，所以并排画，高度不与上面的字节比例对应。
home.figure.caption.en: Figure 4-1 lays both address spaces out by byte range: the two address columns share one scale, so box height is proportional to byte count, and bands too thin for a label are raised to one line. A0h runs from 0 through 255; in A2h, 0-127 are fixed fields, and the page select at 127 decides which of the four pages below bytes 128-255 land in. Pages are alternatives, not stacked regions, so they sit side by side and their heights are not on that byte scale.

home.lede.zh: 这颗模块用一条两线串行总线，把 512 个字节摊开给主机看：一个地址说「我是谁」，另一个说「我现在怎么样」。
home.lede.en: The module exposes 512 bytes over a single two-wire serial bus: one address says who it is, the other says how it is doing.
